actions.name: Flurry
actions.description: The mech can spend 2 PP and a full action to make a full attack with one attack from each upper limb weapon per slot it occupies at a −5 penalty, plus a −1 penalty for each weapon that takes more than 1 slot.

description.value:
Splitting the mech's arms allows for more deft manipulation, but more moving parts presents more engineering challenges and opportunities for enemies.
